name: Kailash Residency
why_it_matters: Ranks #1 of 4 restaurants in Guptkashi on TripAdvisor — the in-house buffet is one of the few places on the Kedarnath route that serves recognisably Garhwali food (kafuli, mandua roti, aloo gutuk) rather than generic North-Indian pilgrim fare.
insider_tip: It's a hotel buffet, not à la carte — time meals to the breakfast and dinner sittings or you'll miss the kitchen. Ask for buransh (rhododendron) squash when in season; it's poured at the table.

name: R. Narayan Pleasant Inn Restaurant
why_it_matters: 30-cover buffet hall attached to one of Guptkashi's larger pilgrim hotels. Pure-veg by design (Char Dham route convention) with a fixed-plate model — breakfast ₹550, dinner ₹650 — and Garhwali fruit juices (malta, buransh) pressed in-house.
insider_tip: This is buffet only, not menu service. Walk in 30 minutes before sitting closes (12pm breakfast, 12am dinner) to get the fresh batch — late servings are warmed-over.
signature_address: Shri Kedarnath Marg, Nala, Guptkashi 246439, Rudraprayag District, Uttarakhand

name: GMVN Guptkashi Tourist Rest House
why_it_matters: Garhwal Mandal Vikas Nigam's state-tourism rest house on the main Kedarnath Road — open to non-residents. Roughly four tables, home-style North Indian, the default fallback when private hotels are full during yatra season.
insider_tip: Order 30 minutes ahead — the kitchen is small and only fires when an order lands. Reviews split sharply on freshness; lunch (cooked once for the dorm crowd) is more reliable than dinner.
signature_address: GMVN Chaukhamba Tourist Complex, Kedarnath Road, near DWD Guest House, Guptkashi 246439

name: Hotel Madhuban Restaurant
why_it_matters: Kitchen attached to one of the older budget hotels on NH-109 — the menu is honestly described as 'basic North Indian, Chinese, Garhwali' which is the realistic ceiling at this price point on the Kedarnath route. Kept open through yatra season.
insider_tip: Stick to the thali and parathas — the Chinese dishes are nominal. About 3-4 km from the Guptkashi helipad, so it's a useful pre-helicopter meal stop.
signature_address: NH-109, Kedarnath Road, Guptkashi 246439, Rudraprayag District, Uttarakhand

name: Hotel Mandakini Restaurant
why_it_matters: Mid-priced bazaar-side hotel kitchen with a fixed-meal model — vegetarian breakfast included for guests, limited à la carte for walk-ins. Functional rather than memorable, but reliable in a town where most restaurants are this category.
insider_tip: It's primarily for guests; walk-in food service depends on which staff is on the floor. Confirm by phone before timing a meal here, especially in lean season (Nov-Mar).
signature_address: Main Bazaar, Guptkashi 246439, Rudraprayag District, Uttarakhand
